summary: The root نَفَدَ (nfd) primarily means to come to an end, be exhausted, or consumed. It can describe provisions running out, property being spent, or a well losing its water.
lane: 4 انقدهُ ذ (S, A, L, Msb, K) and (A, L, K) and (K) He caused it to pass away or come to an end; spent, exhausted, or consumed, it; caused it to fail entirely; caused it to cease; made an end of it. (S, A, L, Msb, K.) -b2- انفدوا مَا عِنْدَهُمْ , and , They spent, exhausted, or consumed, what they had. (A, L.) -b3- وُسْعَهُ He spent, exhausted, or exerted, to the utmost his ability or power (S, L, Msb.) -b4- انفد الَقْوُم The people came to that state that their travelling-provisions were exhausted, or had come to an end: (S, A, L, K:) or, (in the K, and,) their property had passed away and come to an end. (S, L, K.) -b5- انفدت الرَّكِيَّةُ The well lost its water. (L, K.)

headwords.gloss: passed away and came to an end; became spent, exhausted; consumed; failed entirely; ceased

parts.t: passed away and came to an end; became spent, exhausted,

headwords.def: نَفِدَ , aor. نَفَدَ , inf. n. نَفَادٌ (S, A, L, Msb, K) and نَفَدٌ , (L, K,) It (a thing, S, &c.) passed away and came to an end; became spent, exhausted, or consumed; failed entirely; ceased; syn. فَنِى (S, A, L, Msb, K) and َهَبَ (S, L, K) and اِنْقَطَعَ . (L, Msb.)

headwords.def: نافدهُ , (inf. n. مُنَافَدَةٌ , L,) [ He exerted his whole power, or ability, in contention, dispute, or litigation, with him: see مُنَافِدٌ :] he contended with him in arguments, pleas, or allegations, so as to put an end to his argument, and overcome him: (L:) or he contended with him before a judge; (IAth, L, K;) contended, disputed, or litigated with him. (K.) It is said in a trad., إِنْ نَافَدْتَهُمْ نَافَدُوك (S, L) If thou contend with them before a judge, they will so contend with thee: or if thou allege to them, they will allege to thee: (IAth, L;) but accord. to one relation, the verb is with ق (S, L.) and accord. to another, the latter verb is with , نافذوك . (L.)
تنافدوا They contended, disputed, or litigated, together. (A.) See 3, and see also تنافذوا , with .]

headwords.gloss: He exacted, took; received, it fully; wholly

parts.t: Said with reference to a horse. (M, L.)

headwords.def: انتفدهُ : see 4, He exacted, took, or received, it fully, or wholly (K) انتفد مِنْ عَدْوِهِ He exacted the full, or utmost, rate of his running. Said with reference to a horse. (M, L.) انتفد اللَّبَنَ He drew forth the milk. (K.)

headwords.gloss: who exerts his whole power; ability, in contention, dispute; litigation

parts.t: and who does so well, so as to put an end to the arguments, pleas,
allegations, of his adversary, and overcome him:
who contends with his adversary in arguments, pleas,
allegations, so as to put an end to his argument.

headwords.def: مُنَافِدٌ A man who exerts his whole power, or ability, in contention, dispute, or litigation, (S, L,) and who does so well, so as to put an end to the arguments, pleas, or allegations, of his adversary, and overcome him: (L:) who contends with his adversary in arguments, pleas, or allegations, so as to put an end to his argument. (A, L.) One says, لَيْشَ لَهُ رَافِدٌ وَلَا مُنَافِدٌ He has not an aider, or assistant, nor one who contends &c. (A, TA.)

headwords.gloss: In him is that which renders thee in no need of any other; Verily in his wealth is ample provision; Thou wilt find in the countries

parts.t: In him is that which renders thee in no need of any other.
Verily in his wealth is ample provision.
Thou wilt find in the countries,
towns, a place to which to flee and in which to seek gain;

headwords.def: فِيهِ مُنْتَفَدٌ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ In him is that which renders thee in no need of any other. (Aboo-Sa'eed, T, L, K. *) إِنَّ فِى مَالِهِ لَمُنْتَفَدٌ Verily in his wealth is ample provision. (AZ, T, L, K *) تَجَدُ فِى البِلَادِ مُنْتَفَدًا (in the TK مُتَنَفَّدًا ) Thou wilt find in the countries, or towns, a place to which to flee and in which to seek gain; syn. مُرَاغَمًا وَمُضْطَرَبًا (K.) See also مُنْتَفَذٌ .
قَعَدَ مُنْتَفِدًا He set aside, or apart. (IAar. L, K.)
